  Details:
  End-to-end delivery of the Cristo Rei / pacaje_loc2 MAP run (thread 24440): media ingest, public farm profile, SunMint cross-linking, and a render bug fix.
  
  SCOPE OF WORK
  • Media ingest: 13 MOV → MP4 (GPS re-inject) + sidecars + 13 PT VTT transcripts + YouTube ids; 46 HEIC stills archived to farm-media-raw (46/46 verified by name+size diff).
  • Manifest: rebuilt farm_media_manifests/cristo-rei-pacaje-para.json from 13 (video-only) to 59 items (13 MOV + 46 HEIC, 58/59 GPS), matching the sibling schema; gps_center −3.557262/−51.103462.
  • Farm profile page (farms/cristo-rei-pacaje-para/index.html): page + nav + media.json gallery + Leaflet pin; hero IMG_9563 (humans-first), byte-identical on prod (md5 c673a63c…).
  • Bug fix (root-caused): the Brazilian Journey page has TWO structures — BRAZILIAN_PATH_DATA (data map) and journeyOrder (the render array). Cristo Rei was in the data map but not journeyOrder, so sortedStops silently filtered it out (no card, no marker). Cross-checked both structures (26 data keys vs 25 order) → cristo was the only orphan. One-line fix.
  • SunMint reciprocity: verified BOTH directions. map→farm already worked (farm_id == slug); farm→map was generic, fixed to a real deep link https://truesight.me/sunmint.html?plot=CR-PA-P2 (matches the site-wide ?plot=<plot_id> convention used by 4 sibling farms). Deep link verified to resolve on the live map (selector option plot:CR-PA-P2 = "Site Cristo Rei Plot 2 (restoration)").
  • UAT: 12-point end-to-end pass on live prod via cache-busted HTTPS fetches + headless-Chrome renders (JS executed) — all pass.
  • Follow-ups: filed 3 new OPEN_FOLLOWUPS entries (journeyOrder drift guard; video-only manifest generator; SunMint orphan PL-005 duplicate); 2 others were already on the backlog.
  
  EVIDENCE
  • PRs: agroverse_shop_beta #313 (page/nav/media), #316 (hero), #317 (journeyOrder fix), #318 (SunMint reciprocity); farm-media-daemon #24 (GPS parser fix); agentic_ai_context #1001 (OPEN_FOLLOWUPS).
  • Prod syncs: deploy_20260910T140301Z (hero), deploy_20260910T143409Z (nav fix), deploy_20260910T144225Z (reciprocity).
  • Manifest commit 7f219748 (farm_media_manifests).
  
  NOTES
  • Prod LIVE verified (repo blob == beta blob; raw.githubusercontent/CDN staleness re-confirmed as a known cache-lie class — verified via contents API).
  • Held by design, not in scope: on-chain geo anchor, loc1/loc3, CR-PA-P1, plot-id convention.
